// Package rt is a stand-in for gosuda.org/hqq/bindgen/rt in the behavior tests of the Go emitter: the
// generated client is compiled against it instead of the real runtime, so the tests can script the
// server side without a link. Conn.Serve receives the complete request frame (header and body) and
// returns the complete response frame. codec.go is a verbatim copy of the real helpers.
package rt

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/binary"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
)

var le = binary.LittleEndian

const (
	HeaderSize    = 16
	DetailMax     = 1024
	DetailReserve = 1032
	MsgMax        = 32
	ErrBodyMax    = 37
	VarSlack      = 11
	NullLen       = 0xFFFFFFFF
	Align16       = 16
)

var (
	ErrInvalidArg    = errors.New("hqqbg: invalid argument")
	ErrForeignHandle = errors.New("hqqbg: handle belongs to another session")
	ErrFutureUsed    = errors.New("hqqbg: future already waited for or discarded")
	ErrConcurrentUse = errors.New("hqqbg: re-entrant use of a Conn")
)

type Iface struct {
	Service string
	Digest  [32]byte
	Ops     []string
}

type Options struct{}

type StatusError struct {
	Func   string
	Status uint32
	Msg    string
}

func (e *StatusError) Error() string { return fmt.Sprintf("%s: status %d: %s", e.Func, e.Status, e.Msg) }

type LibError struct {
	Func   string
	Code   int64
	Detail string
}

func (e *LibError) Error() string { return fmt.Sprintf("%s: library error %d: %s", e.Func, e.Code, e.Detail) }

type ProtocolError struct{ Func string }

func (e *ProtocolError) Error() string { return e.Func + ": malformed response body" }

type Handle struct {
	id uint32
	c  *Conn
}

func (h Handle) ID() uint32  { return h.id }
func (h Handle) IsNil() bool { return h.id == 0 }

// Conn is a scripted session. Requests are recorded; a request is answered when it is submitted.
type Conn struct {
	Iface *Iface
	Serve func(req []byte) []byte

	// Observations for the tests.
	Requests    [][]byte // every committed request frame
	LastBodyLen int      // bodyLen argument of the last BeginRequest
	LastRespMax int64    // respMax argument of the last BeginRequest
	Broken      []string // functions whose response was reported malformed

	nextID uint32
	txOpen bool
	rxOpen bool
}

func NewConn(iface *Iface, serve func(req []byte) []byte) *Conn { return &Conn{Iface: iface, Serve: serve} }

func Dial(ctx context.Context, listener string, iface *Iface, opts Options) (*Conn, error) {
	return nil, errors.New("fake rt cannot dial")
}

func (c *Conn) Close() error { return nil }
func (c *Conn) Kill()        {}

func (c *Conn) NewHandle(id uint32) Handle {
	if id == 0 {
		return Handle{}
	}
	return Handle{id, c}
}

func (c *Conn) CheckHandle(h Handle, nullable bool) error {
	switch {
	case h.id == 0 && nullable:
		return nil
	case h.id == 0:
		return ErrInvalidArg
	case h.c != c:
		return ErrForeignHandle
	}
	return nil
}

type Enc struct {
	op   uint16
	body []byte
}

// Body returns a slice filled with 0xA5: a generated stub that does not write a byte, padding included,
// leaves the pattern in the frame, as a recycled ring slot would.
func (e *Enc) Body() []byte { return e.body }

func (c *Conn) BeginRequest(op uint16, bodyLen int, respMax int64) (*Enc, error) {
	if c.txOpen || c.rxOpen {
		return nil, ErrConcurrentUse
	}
	if bodyLen < 0 || bodyLen > 1<<24 || respMax < 0 || respMax > 1<<30 {
		return nil, ErrInvalidArg
	}
	c.LastBodyLen, c.LastRespMax = bodyLen, respMax
	c.txOpen = true
	body := make([]byte, bodyLen)
	for i := range body {
		body[i] = 0xA5
	}
	return &Enc{op, body}, nil
}

type Call struct {
	id      uint32
	pending bool
	resp    []byte
}

func (c *Call) ID() uint32 { return c.id }

func (c *Conn) Submit(e *Enc) (*Call, error) {
	if !c.txOpen {
		return nil, ErrConcurrentUse
	}
	c.txOpen = false
	c.nextID++
	frame := make([]byte, HeaderSize+len(e.body))
	frame[0] = 1
	le.PutUint16(frame[2:], e.op)
	le.PutUint32(frame[4:], c.nextID)
	le.PutUint32(frame[8:], uint32(len(e.body)))
	copy(frame[HeaderSize:], e.body)
	c.Requests = append(c.Requests, frame)
	return &Call{id: c.nextID, pending: true, resp: c.Serve(frame)}, nil
}

func (c *Conn) Abort(e *Enc) { c.txOpen = false }

type Dec struct {
	Body   []byte
	Detail bool
	Fail   bool

	c    *Conn
	op   uint16
	open bool
}

func (c *Conn) opName(op uint16) string {
	if op >= 1 && int(op) <= len(c.Iface.Ops) {
		return c.Iface.Ops[op-1]
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("op%d", op)
}

func (c *Conn) Wait(call *Call, id uint32) (Dec, error) {
	if call == nil || !call.pending || call.id != id {
		return Dec{}, ErrFutureUsed
	}
	if c.rxOpen {
		return Dec{}, ErrConcurrentUse
	}
	call.pending = false
	r := call.resp
	if len(r) < HeaderSize || r[0] != 2 || le.Uint32(r[4:]) != id || int(le.Uint32(r[8:])) != len(r)-HeaderSize {
		return Dec{}, errors.New("fake rt: bad response frame")
	}
	op, flags, status := le.Uint16(r[2:]), r[1], le.Uint32(r[12:])
	body := r[HeaderSize:]
	if status != 0 {
		msg, _, _ := GetStr(body, 0, MsgMax)
		return Dec{}, &StatusError{Func: c.opName(op), Status: status, Msg: msg}
	}
	c.rxOpen = true
	return Dec{Body: body, Detail: flags&1 != 0, Fail: flags&2 != 0, c: c, op: op, open: true}, nil
}

func (d *Dec) Release() {
	if d.open {
		d.open = false
		d.c.rxOpen = false
	}
}

func (d *Dec) Malformed() error {
	fn := d.c.opName(d.op)
	d.c.Broken = append(d.c.Broken, fn)
	return &ProtocolError{Func: fn}
}

func (d *Dec) LibError(fn string, code int64, g2Size int) error {
	var detail string
	if d.Detail {
		s, end, err := GetStr(d.Body, Align(g2Size, 8), DetailMax)
		if err != nil || end != len(d.Body) {
			return d.Malformed()
		}
		detail = s
	} else if len(d.Body) != g2Size {
		return d.Malformed()
	}
	return &LibError{Func: fn, Code: code, Detail: detail}
}
